sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • Optional card colours (title, hover border) were saved as `#ffffff` instead
  • Category terms were not removed on uninstall (with "delete data" enabled)
  • The map object list cache was not cleared when a category term was renamed,
  • The object editor script now declares the Yandex Maps API as a dependency

Changed

  • List search field and sort dropdown now sit side by side on a single row
